# Patrick Coleman

> Personal site of Patrick Coleman, a generalist who builds products, helps companies grow, and is working on Alloglot, a language learning app.

## About
- [Patrick Coleman](https://pscoleman.me/): Biography, interests, languages, and social/contact links.

## Translations
- [Translation index](https://pscoleman.me/translations): Literary translations from Spanish and Japanese into English, with author and source attribution.
- [Axolotl](https://pscoleman.me/translations/axolotl): Julio Cortázar, translated from Spanish.
- [The Bakery Attack Take 2](https://pscoleman.me/translations/bakery-attack): Haruki Murakami, translated from Japanese.
- [Haiku](https://pscoleman.me/translations/basho-haiku): Ten poems by Matsuo Bashō, with Japanese originals.
- [Genjō Kōan](https://pscoleman.me/translations/genjo-koan): Dōgen, with Japanese original text.

## Updates
- [RSS feed](https://pscoleman.me/feed.xml): Translation titles, dates, summaries, and canonical links.

Patrick Coleman is the translator of these works; the original authors are credited separately. Alloglot is currently at https://aloglot.com.
